B.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , B.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE , B.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE , B.BUYER BUYER_CODE , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE , D.MAKER_PART_NO --모델번호 추가 , C.DS_SEQ , A.AGENT , D.PR_NO , D.PR_SEQ FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPORS C, ICOMPRDT D WHERE A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND A.PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_po_no}||'%')
AND B.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_legacy_po_no}||'%')
AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%')
AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER(+) AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO(+) AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ(+) AND C.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.BUYER=D.BUYER --추가 AND B.PR_NO= D.PR_NO --추가 AND B.PR_SEQ=D.PR_SEQ --추가 ) X, ICOMIVDT Y WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.PO_NO = Y.PO_NO(+) AND X.PO_SEQ = Y.PO_SEQ(+) AND X.DS_DATE = Y.DS_DATE(+) AND Y.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
AND DECODE(X.DS_DATE, NULL,'발주', DECODE(Y.INV_NO, NULL, '수주접수', DECODE(Y.DELIVERY_DATE,NULL,'거래명세서생성','납품완료'))) = #{st_status}
